_comment: Golden baseline of the 114C.6 administrative step-up policy -- which
routes require a recent high-assurance (Aal2) authentication, layered on
TOP of the role gate in human_account_route_policy_baseline.json (a route
can be both admin-gated AND step-up-gated). Pins crate::auth::requires_step_up.
Passkey *registration* is deliberately absent even though the plan's
sensitive-action list names it: gating an account's FIRST passkey on
step-up would deadlock (step-up itself needs a passkey). That route
enforces step-up handler-side with a first-passkey exemption instead --
see crate::auth::requires_step_up's doc comment. The step-up ceremony
routes (/auth/step-up/*) are absent because a not-yet-Aal2 session must
be able to reach them to step up at all.
